title: Settings
subtitle: Update your shop information
compliance_desc: If a health inspector visits your shop, show them this PDF. It has your full stock list, expiry dates, and 30 days of sales — everything they need to see.
shop_code_hint: Tellers use this to log in. It cannot be changed.
placeholder_reg_number: e.g. CIPC or municipal reg number
hint_reg_number: Your CIPC or municipal registration number. Shows on compliance reports.
placeholder_location: e.g. 12 Main Rd, Khayelitsha, Cape Town
hint_location: Your shop address. Shows on compliance reports.
label_threshold: Warn me when a product has fewer than
msg_download_failed: Could not download report. Try again.
data_desc: Download a copy of everything Movestock stores about your shop — your products, sales, staff, suppliers and daily checks. POPIA, the South African data law, gives you the right to a copy of your data at any time.
data_error: Could not export your data. Please try again.
danger_desc: Permanently delete your shop and everything in it — products, sales, staff and reports. This cannot be undone.
danger_confirm: This permanently deletes your shop and everything in it. You can sign up again later with the same login. Are you sure?
danger_error: Could not delete your account. Please try again.
profit_tracking_desc: See how much profit you make each day. You'll need to enter a cost price for each product.
profit_tracking_hint_missing_one: {count} product still needs a cost price
profit_tracking_hint_missing_other: {count} products still need a cost price
subscribe_trial_days_left_one: You have {count} day left on your free trial.
subscribe_trial_days_left_other: You have {count} days left on your free trial.
subscribe_payment_methods: Pay with card, EFT, or SnapScan via PayFast
subscribe_method_eft_desc: Manual bank transfer. Activated within 1 business day after we see your payment.
subscribe_method_payfast_desc: Card, instant EFT or SnapScan. Renews automatically each month.
subscribe_payment_safety: Your payment is processed by PayFast or your bank. We never see or store your card details.
eft_page_subtitle: Transfer R{amount} from your bank to ours.
eft_warning_title: Use your shop code as the reference
eft_warning_body: Without your shop code as the payment reference, we cannot match your deposit and your shop will not be activated.
eft_reference_hint: Type this exactly — it's your shop code.
eft_bank_not_configured: Bank details haven't been set yet. Please WhatsApp support to ask for them.
eft_after_pay_body: We check our bank account once a day on business days. Once we see your deposit with your shop code as the reference, we activate your shop. This usually takes 1 business day.
eft_load_error_body: Please check your internet and try again.
subscribe_success_desc: Your subscription is now active. You have full access to Movestock.
subscribe_cancelled_desc: No worries — you can subscribe any time.
subscribe_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
subscribe_error_connect: Could not connect. Please check your internet and try again.
fund_interest_help: Show the Spaza Shop Support Fund eligibility checker on your dashboard.
